# Internal compliance memo: IPS concentration and band review as of 15 April 2026

**To:** Chief Compliance Officer
**Scope:** All 92 household folders. For each one I used the custodian positions and cash as of 2026-04-15, the IPS in `portfolio/ips.json`, and the CRM in `crm/crm.json`. Each holding is measured as a share of the household's total value, positions plus cash. Each security is assigned to the asset class its own IPS gives it. Cash is counted in the total but belongs to no asset class. The portfolio system's positions (`portfolio/positions.json`) have the same 688 position rows as the custodian, and the ten flagged stock market values were checked in both sources and agree. This memo describes what the records show and draws no legal conclusion.

## No documented exceptions anywhere
I searched every CRM file for "exception", "concentration", "waiver" and similar words, and read the CRM text of each flagged household. None of the 92 households has a recorded exception of any kind, signed or unsigned. So every household below has no documented exception on file.

## Single stocks above the IPS concentration limit (5 households)
| Household | Stock | Value | Household total | Share | IPS limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HH-0221 | Varrick Pharma Holdings (SEC-0040) | 720,721.10 + 496,234.20 = 1,216,955.30 | 3,020,567.41 | 40.29% | 25% |
| HH-0816 | Halvern Health Holdings (SEC-0005) | 931,224.14 + 569,484.30 = 1,500,708.44 | 3,058,018.17 | 49.07% | 20% |
| HH-3058 | Bramwell Devices Group (SEC-0028) | 825,134.04 + 440,512.00 = 1,265,646.04 | 3,895,524.87 | 32.49% | 15% |
| HH-0984 | Ardley Rail Group (SEC-0048) | 601,199.25 + 431,784.00 = 1,032,983.25 | 2,889,161.08 | 35.75% | 30% |
| HH-0376 | Fenwright Networks Group (SEC-0032) | 870,914.40 + 446,916.60 = 1,317,831.00 | 3,494,538.51 | 37.71% | 30% |

In all five households the CRM records quarterly employer RSU releases in 2025, with the shares delivered to the `…0002` account.

## Asset classes outside their IPS bands (10 households)
| Household | Outside band | Allowed range |
|---|---|---|
| HH-3058 | US equity 68.11%; International equity 4.11%; Fixed income 15.04% | 55–65%; 6–14%; 23–33% |
| HH-3462 | Fixed income 17.75% | 25–35% |

| HH-5814 | US equity 55.89%; Fixed income 32.96% | 45–55%; 35–45% |
| HH-8312 | US equity 72.06%; Fixed income 27.01% | 50–60%; 35–45% |
| HH-8865 | US equity 70.71%; Fixed income 28.47% | 50–60%; 35–45% |
| HH-9234 | US equity 65.31%; Fixed income 24.47% | 50–60%; 25–35% |
| HH-9571 | US equity 65.74%; Fixed income 24.49% | 50–60%; 25–35% |

That makes 14 households in total; HH-3058 is on both lists. Every other single-stock holding was below its household's limit. The largest were Fallowmere Utilities Group in HH-0926 at 17.15% (limit 30%) and Corriden Card Holdings in HH-0193 at 18.76% (limit 27%). Every other asset class of the remaining 78 households was within its band.

## Points for the reviewer
- **Stock or fund.** No file records a security's type. I took 15 tickers to be single companies (Bramwell Devices Group, Ostrel Semiconductor Group, Corriden Card Holdings, Fenwright Networks Group, Fallowmere Utilities Group, Ellisar Search Holdings, Halvern Health Holdings, Varrick Pharma Holdings, Orrin Software Group, Velloran Apparel Group, Corvane Semiconductor Holdings, Brisley Health Group, Ardley Rail Group, Ashvane Bank Group, Dunmere Energy Group) and treated all others as funds. That reading should be confirmed.
- **Cash.** Cash counts in the total but in no asset class, so large cash balances lower every class weight. HH-3462's fixed-income shortfall comes largely from 430,396.37 of cash in SYN-34620002, where the RSU shares were delivered.
- **Narrow margins.** HH-9234's fixed income is 24.47% against a 25% floor (0.53 points), and HH-6590's US equity is 50.24% against a 50% ceiling (0.24 points).
- **Near the edge but inside.** HH-3462's US equity is 64.24% against a 65% ceiling.
